_note: The workload matrix. Upstream's own reproduction (1024 in / 1024 out, 1024 requests at concurrency 512, no output-length jitter) is the anchor; the two other scored points keep the same request shape at 384 and 256 concurrent requests, which is the range over which the regression is measurable. c=128, where a repair gains nothing, is the guard: measured and never averaged in, because a high-concurrency repair must not tax the lower-concurrency decode path. Concurrency is the engine's max_num_seqs, so every point is its own engine boot.
